title: Blind Spot Alerts and Detection
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on blind spot monitoring and alerts, but many sampled fragments also use the word "spot" for unrelated storage or visibility comments, limiting coherence.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise blind spot detection and related safety tech for making driving easier and improving awareness.

negative.summary: Negative reviews report blind spot warning malfunctions or design issues, though some sampled negatives are unrelated uses of the word "spot".

mixed.summary: The only mixed review is unrelated to blind spot monitoring and instead complains about lacking a dedicated spot for small personal items.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention questions, adaptation, or feature requests about audible blind spot alerts, with a few unrelated blind-spot or storage references.

limitations: Many sampled fragments use "spot" or "blind spot" in unrelated ways, such as storage locations or sightlines, so the topic cluster is partly noisy.
Most sampled reviews are undetermined, which limits confidence in summarizing clear customer sentiment beyond the few explicit positive and negative examples.
Examples are insufficient to characterize specific failure modes or feature behavior in detail.
